name: remote-replies-from-a-subfolder-are-labelled
description: In remote mode a reply from a session working in a subfolder of the project is logged with a [folder] label, while Replay Last Reply keeps the reply without it. A reply from the project folder itself has no label.
reason: With several sessions in one project the label tells their replies apart on screen, but reading the label aloud on Replay would speak a folder name as if Claude had said it.
source: AppState.handleRemoteEvent(.stop) ('Unprefixed, so Replay Last Reply speaks the reply and not the label') and remoteCwdPrefix

script.reason: A reply from a session in a subfolder.
A reply from the project folder itself.
